noDirectLocalisation.polyvagal-theory: Polyvagal Theory remains scientifically contested and should not be presented as a validated discrete anatomical map.
noDirectLocalisation.structural-dissociation: Structural dissociation is a theoretical clinical model, not a claim that personality or dissociative parts occupy separate anatomical regions.
noDirectLocalisation.window-of-tolerance: The Window of Tolerance is a clinical heuristic, not a validated measurable neurobiological threshold or single brain location.
noDirectLocalisation.attachment-neuroscience-trauma: Attachment is distributed, relational and developmentally contextual. It should not be represented as a fixed neural type or single location.
noDirectLocalisation.developmental-trauma: Developmental trauma is an exposure and developmental formulation, not a single localisable brain lesion or biomarker.
noDirectLocalisation.complex-ptsd-neuroscience: Complex PTSD is a clinical diagnostic construct with heterogeneous group-level findings, not a single validated neural localisation.
noDirectLocalisation.moral-injury: Moral injury is a clinical and psychosocial construct and should not be reduced to a single anatomical location.
noDirectLocalisation.intergenerational-trauma: Intergenerational trauma findings do not justify representing an inherited or localised brain lesion.
noDirectLocalisation.neurobiology-emdr: EMDR neurobiological mechanisms remain under investigation. No single validated neural mechanism should be presented as established.
noDirectLocalisation.bilateral-stimulation-emdr: Bilateral stimulation is a treatment procedure, not a localisable brain structure.
noDirectLocalisation.adaptive-information-processing: Adaptive Information Processing is a theoretical clinical model, not an anatomical map.
noDirectLocalisation.mechanisms-change-emdr: Multiple mechanisms have been proposed for EMDR and the evidence does not support one exclusive localised mechanism.
noDirectLocalisation.current-evidence-emdr: Treatment efficacy evidence is not itself an anatomical localisation.
noDirectLocalisation.clinical-indications-emdr: Clinical indications are treatment-decision concepts, not brain locations.
noDirectLocalisation.eight-phases-emdr: The eight-phase protocol is a treatment structure, not neuroanatomy.
noDirectLocalisation.orienting-response-emdr: The orienting-response account is a mechanism hypothesis and should not be displayed as an established discrete neural localisation.
noDirectLocalisation.clinical-integration-limitations-emdr: Clinical integration and limitations are practice-level concepts, not anatomical locations.
noDirectLocalisation.contraindications-precautions-emdr: Treatment precautions are clinical safety concepts, not anatomical locations.
noDirectLocalisation.qeeg-adhd-evidence: qEEG findings do not provide a validated individual diagnostic brain map for ADHD.
noDirectLocalisation.qeeg-autism-evidence: Group-level EEG findings in autism are heterogeneous and are not a validated individual localisation.
noDirectLocalisation.qeeg-anxiety-depression-evidence: Group-level EEG findings do not constitute a validated individual diagnostic localisation.
noDirectLocalisation.qeeg-tbi-evidence: qEEG should not be represented as a validated standalone localisation or diagnosis of mild TBI.
noDirectLocalisation.personality-disorders-neuroscience: Personality disorders do not have a single validated diagnostic brain location or biomarker.
